This effect is typical of modern UI design, where the header’s background becomes translucent and blurred to maintain visibility of content behind it while still being distinct.  

2. **Content & Style**: The header includes the “Coursia” logo (purple circular icon with text), navigation links (“Fonctionnalités”, “Comment ça marche”, “Tarifs”), a language selector (“FR”), and a “Commencer gratuitement” button. The text and elements are clearly legible against the blurred background, with the button having a purple - hued, rounded design.  


In summary, after scrolling, the header features a frosted glass/blur background, with the logo, navigation links, language selector, and call - to - action button all visible and styled to stand out against this translucent backdrop.  

The answer is Yes, the header has a frosted glass/blur background effect. It includes the Coursia logo, navigation links, a language selector, and a "Commencer gratuitement" button, with the background appearing translucent and blurred.
